exec card mail recv --help
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/help.txt

-- golden/help.txt --
Usage: card mail recv [flags]

Receive messages.

Read unread actor mail by default. Global observation is always read-only.

Flags:
  -h, --help                 Show context-sensitive help.
      --store=PATH           Physical Cardamom store directory. Overrides
                             automatic discovery ($CARDAMOM_STORE).
      --board=BOARD          Coordination board ID or exact name
                             ($CARDAMOM_BOARD).
      --actor=ACTOR          Identity that owns active claims and attributes
                             changes. Defaults to the current OS username
                             ($CARDAMOM_ACTOR).
      --json                 Emit machine-readable JSON or JSON Lines output.
  -q, --quiet                Suppress status notices while preserving requested
                             output and errors.
  -V, --version              Print version information and exit. This flag must
                             precede any command.

      --peek                 Read messages without marking them read.
      --all                  Include messages that were already read.
      --clear                Mark unread messages read without printing them.
      --global               Observe messages across all recipients without
                             changing read state.
      --tail                 Poll until canceled and emit each delivery once per
                             session.
      --age=DURATION         Include messages no older than this Go duration,
                             such as 30m or 24h. Zero has no age limit.
      --limit=COUNT          Return at most this many messages per read.
                             Zero has no count limit.
      --interval=DURATION    Delay between tail polls in Go duration syntax.
                             Values below 1s use 1s.
